about: Temporary exceptions to TARGET_ARCHITECTURE invariants I-1 to I-11, each naming the phase (and GOAL task) that removes it, and the I-4 sites that parse a host format rather than user or model meaning. Read by tests/test_architecture_invariants.py: every listed case must still occur (no stale entry), every occurring case must be listed (no silent violation), no entry may name a landed phase, and neither list may gain an entry compared with the commit that introduced this file (I-12). landed_phases only grows; a phase is added at its gate.
